input: Any commit that modifies /moves/queen_d8.text or /moves/bishop_c8.text must be signed by that piece and co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys, and any commit that modifies any /moves/<agent>.text path must be co-signed by at least one key from the agent whose own plan it is, so that greed and amnesia from repeat offenders cannot push through an off-plan move.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/queen_d8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_c8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false)
